title: Assertion
text: Check whether signal is zero, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Enable assertion} enables or disable check, {Simulation callback when assertion fails} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion and {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the whether to stop simulation when check. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable check on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails "" (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Whether to stop simulation when check fails on (default) | off
